svg.title: CKODEX · Sealed Diamond · v1.1 with signature tension
svg.desc: CKODEX logo mark · v1.1 · variant A · sealed diamond with two ownable moves. (1) Fixed 1.764:1 ratio between outer and inner diamond — a mathematically-locked proof relationship (outer radius 52 · inner radius 29.48, rounded to 29) that only CKODEX owns; any other diamond-in-diamond logo is visibly different. (2) One sanctioned asymmetry: the NW cardinal tick is half-length (3 px vs 6 px for the other three). The NW (upper-left) direction is the input vector; the shortened tick reads as 'input is always inspected' — a tacit trust anchor. The remaining three ticks at full length encode approval · execution · attestation.
